title: Dreamlike AI Dance Video - "Feel It In My Bones" - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
Dance party Friday today. This is a kooky one. I remembered this from a few years ago that if you add “(______) core” into your prompt, insert some recognizable thing, it adds that item and weirdness into your images. I used to try all sorts of stuff.  Zappa core was a good one. This is McDonalds core. It changed the characters so they have some Ronald McDonald style lol. Why? I don’t know, just because. It added the arches here and there too and some French fries. I just like to be silly sometimes. Animated using #veo3 and song made using @suno   Feel It In My Bones

#ai #aiart #aivideo #aimusic #suno #aiimages #aidance #surreal

top_comments.author: @forgiga
top_comments.text:
Hey Kelly! You are a blessed artist and incredible creator! This is one of those moments where AI doesn’t replace talent — it highlights it. I’ve seen tons of AI-generated videos, and most of them only show what the AI can do, not what the artist can do. Anyone can type a prompt, but not everyone has the vision, imagination, taste, concept, style, and eye for detail that truly make something special.
You’ve got all of that. Surrealism isn't the easiest art style to express yourself in, but you've nailed it. Keep going — I genuinely wish you a powerful and successful future!
